answer:
The App side of your Habit tracker now has a "Weekly goals" section under Today. It starts with Walk 5, Read 4 and Stretch 3. Each habit has a progress bar and a count like "2 / 5". The count turns amber once you hit the goal. To change a goal, type a new number (0–7) in the box next to the habit.

The week runs Monday to today, so it starts again at 0 each Monday. Today is Monday, so this week only has today in it so far.

The goals are saved in the app's own data, not in the note's text. Nothing in the note's table changed. The app check came back clean. I also raised the tiny day letters in the history grid from 10px to 12px so they pass the check.
